<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1929776_compli_0.CPMEvidence</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CPMEvidence</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CPMEvidence = Class.create();
CPMEvidence.prototype = {
  ALLOWED: { 'image/png': 1, 'image/jpeg': 1, 'image/gif': 1, 'image/webp': 1, 'application/pdf': 1 },
  BATCH_MINUTES: 15,

  initialize: function() {
    this.util = new CPMUtil();
    this.access = new CPMAccess();
  },

  // Called by the REST resource. Returns { status, body }.
  receive: function(serviceControlId, evidenceId, file, stream) {
    var sc = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_control');
    if (!sc.get(serviceControlId) || !this.access.canWorkOn(sc))
      return this._fail(403, 'You cannot add evidence to this control.');
    if ((sc.control.method + '') != 'upload' || sc.getValue('active') != '1' || sc.getValue('exempt') == '1')
      return this._fail(400, 'This control does not accept evidence.');

    var problem = this._validate(file);
    if (problem) return this._fail(400, problem);

    var evidence = evidenceId ? this._openBatch(sc, evidenceId) : null;
    var isNew = !evidence;
    if (isNew) evidence = this._create(sc);

    var attachmentId = new GlideSysAttachment().writeContentStream(evidence, file.name, file.type, stream);
    if (!attachmentId) {
      if (isNew) evidence.deleteRecord();
      return this._fail(500, 'The file could not be saved.');
    }
    if (isNew) this._publish(sc, evidence);

    return { status: 200, body: { evidence: evidence.getUniqueValue(), number: evidence.getValue('number') } };
  },

  _validate: function(file) {
    var maxMb = this.util.intProp('max_file_mb', 10);
    if (!file.name) return 'The file name is missing.';
    if (!this.ALLOWED[file.type]) return 'Only images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP) and PDF files are accepted.';
    if (!/\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|pdf)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'This file extension is not allowed.';
    if (!file.size) return 'The file is empty.';
    if (file.size > maxMb * 1024 * 1024) return 'The file is larger than ' + maxMb + ' MB.';
    return '';
  },

  // Several files dropped together share one Evidence record
  _openBatch: function(sc, evidenceId) {
    var evidence = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_evidence');
    if (!evidence.get(evidenceId)) return null;
    if (evidence.getValue('service_control') != sc.getUniqueValue()) return null;
    if (evidence.getValue('uploaded_by') != gs.getUserID()) return null;
    if (evidence.getValue('status') != 'current') return null;
    var ageMs = GlideDateTime.subtract(new GlideDateTime(evidence.getValue('sys_created_on')), new GlideDateTime()).getNumericValue();
    return ageMs <= this.BATCH_MINUTES * 60000 ? evidence : null;
  },

  _create: function(sc) {
    var days = parseInt(sc.control.validity_days + '', 10) || 365;
    var evidence = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_evidence');
    evidence.initialize();
    evidence.setValue('service_control', sc.getUniqueValue());
    evidence.setValue('collected_on', this.util.today());
    evidence.setValue('valid_until', this.util.addDays(this.util.today(), days));
    evidence.setValue('status', 'current');
    evidence.setValue('uploaded_by', gs.getUserID());
    evidence.insert();
    return evidence;
  },

  _publish: function(sc, evidence) {
    var older = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_evidence');
    older.addQuery('service_control', sc.getUniqueValue());
    older.addQuery('status', 'current');
    older.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', evidence.getUniqueValue());
    older.query();
    while (older.next()) {
      older.setValue('status', 'superseded');
      older.update();
    }

    sc.setValue('evidence', evidence.getUniqueValue());
    sc.setValue('valid_until', evidence.getValue('valid_until'));
    sc.setValue('state', this.util.stateFor(evidence.getValue('valid_until')));
    sc.setValue('notified_state', '');
    sc.update();
    new CPMPosture().recalculate(sc.getValue('business_service'));
  },

  _fail: function(status, message) {
    return { status: status, body: { error: message } };
  },

  type: 'CPMEvidence'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-24 11:50:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>ffc77e7e73001310a621f2024ab8b7ff</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CPMEvidence</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_ffc77e7e73001310a621f2024ab8b7ff</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-24 11:50:04</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
